event.proposal: Family: position representation. Retained incumbent is 3185 parameters at 99.990000%, a +0.990000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: the most recent accepted result is attempt-0029, learned positional rank 3 (3185, 99.99%); the most recent distinct failed positional substitution is attempt-0017's fixed rank-8 basis, while all lower learned ranks tested under the successful schedule so far have qualified; 9 prior position-representation macro-attempts plus the rank-7 schedule reattempt. Hypothesis: two learned positional coordinates with a learned 2-to-14 projection may still represent the task's fixed positional role structure, saving 49 actual parameters (3185 to 3136). This is a representational positional factorization, not parameterization-preserving scalar pruning. It is more informative than the nearest untested rank-1 alternative because rank 2 tests the final multi-coordinate representation before a one-dimensional positional code.
